items.label: 36" Height Versatile & Practical Coffee Bar
items.value: This accent storage cabinet is perfect for small spaces and kitchens without pantries, providing ample storage while taking up minimal space. The 29" wide top is ideal for a coffee maker and cups, while 3 adjustable shelves provide flexible and hidden storage for living room, kitchen, hallway or dining essentials in different sizes.

items.label: Dimensions and Material
items.value: 29.53"W x 13.39"D x 36.00"H with adjustable shelves. Crafted with FSC-certified wood, our product supports sustainability and promotes responsible forest management. Made from high-quality MDF board with a rustic oak wood grain finish, it adds a farmhouse touch to your home bar. The steel has a powder finish to prevent rust, ensuring long lasting.

items.label: Not Wobbles
items.value: Thanks to heavy duty metal frame and support tube under bottom shelf, the small bar cabinet stands quit stable. We also provide anti-tip device, you can mount this bar cart to the wall to avoid unexpected tipping. 4pcs pre-assembled plastic pads avoids your wood floor from scratching. The doors designed to close quietly and lockable for secure storage

items.label: High Weight Capacity Rustic Cabinet
items.value: The bar cabinet station top can bear 300 lbs home supplies and each shelf hold up to 100 lbs. With its ample storage space and strong weight capacity, you can display everything you need close at hand.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: This wood metal small storage buffet cabinet takes around 25 minutes to assemble. Necessary hardware and instruction are provided.
